title: VXAce The Wastes (Open World Post Apocalyptic RPG - For fans of Fallout and S.T.A.L.K.E.R)

posts.author: cthulhusquid
posts.body:
Warning: Contains strong language, use of alcohol/drugs/smoking, and non-explicit sexual content.
Inspired by S.T.A.L.K.E.R (including the Misery mod), Fallout 1/2, Philip K. Dick, and other media.
Story
The Flash. The so-called “end of humanity”. Or at least, that’s what they say.
200 years later, the ravages of nuclear fire are but a memory in the wasteland known as “New Canum”. Humans moved on, and live their lives like they’ve always done. Across the mountains, the endless sandy tracts of the Wastes beckons Scavengers to uncover the secrets of the old world.
Nearby in Waste-Town, a Waste-Hunter known as Rex comes across an old man locked in a Government prison cell, charged under mysterious circumstances. The man urges him to go to the nearby Outpost, which lies between the Wastes and civilization, and deliver what he calls “proof of the Government making nuclear weapons” to his estranged son.
Seeing the profit potential, Rex takes on the job. Unknowingly, he’s about to be entangled in a web of factions vying for control over New Canum, and even the destiny of the wasteland itself.
Features
Player Agency
Have total agency with decisions, including the agency to fail. Want to open that package you’re supposed to deliver? Go for it. Want to sell that thing someone said was really, really important but you’re strapped for Scraps? Go for it. Want to fight that Headcase mutant with only a zip gun and the clothes on your back? F*ckin’ go for it!
Decide the outcome of sensitive situations. As a neutral party, some settlements will require you to take a side.
Immersive World and Economy
Talk to every NPC and see what they think about the surrounding area, factions, etc. Some might even have quests, know stash locations, or have items to trade.
Explore New Canum in daylight, dusty wind, sandstorms, heatwaves, and radiation storms.
Brave deadly Anomalous Zones to find Artifacts, mysterious items born from radiation and time.
Sprint if you’d like, but you’ll tire after a short while.
Scavenge over 600 items and equipment from scrap piles, stashes, and backpacks looted from the dead. Some are trash, others treasure.
Repair equipment as it deteriorates. You might want to keep those cheap guns, because that assault rifle is going to cost an arm and a leg to fix.
Open locked doors and containers with lockpicks. They can break!
Ambient and industrial soundtrack.
Survival System
Experience the harshness of the post apocalypse as you deal with hunger, thirst, sleep, and general health. Too much Sniff Dust and Energy Drinks makes for a dead Scav.
Scavenge fruit from bushes, mutant meat from kills, and water from sources across New Canum.
Use campfires and portable cooking stoves to cook food and purify water.
Radiation Poisoning and Mutations
Radiation is everywhere in New Canum, even the food and water. Manage your radiation level through medication and doctor services, stick to eating clean, or toe the line between life and death by cheaping out.
Gain mutations at certain radiation thresholds. These have both benefits and downsides.
Tactical Combat
Use over 100 real-world factory produced and scrap metal weapon variants to fight off bandits and mutants, ranging from pristine condition to having shot-out barrels.
Use real-world ammo, such as hollow point and armor piercing incendiary bullets. However, time wasn’t kind to all of these, so some ammo boxes may contain duds.
Hide behind light, medium, and heavy cover, offering varying degrees of protection. What will stop pistol rounds won’t stop rifle rounds.
Harness Artifacts to burn, shock or simply gain an edge over your enemies.
Unjam firearms in the thick of battle, because some are simply better made than others.
